symptomShortText: Sink mark on enclosure cover molded in cavity 1 - blocked cooling channel left a hot spot

defect.defectText: Sink mark and internal void on cosmetic injection molded surface

causesIshikawa.description: Mold setter started the job with the released recipe
Cavity 1 cooling channel of the WC-MOLD-01 mold blocked by limescale - flow 2.1 l/min vs min 6.0, hot spot under the boss
Holding pressure 5.5s at 650 bar as released after 8D-10049040
PC/ABS resin lot RS-4471 dried to 0.02% moisture
Chilled water supply hardness not monitored

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did the customer reject the enclosure covers?
fiveWhyChain.answer: Sink mark depth reached 0.28mm against max 0.05mm on parts from cavity 1

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did cavity 1 parts sink while cavity 2 parts did not?
fiveWhyChain.answer: Cavity 1 cooled slower: its channel carried 2.1 l/min instead of at least 6.0 l/min

fiveWhyChain.question: Why was the cavity 1 cooling flow restricted? (root cause)
fiveWhyChain.answer: Limescale blocked the channel because the mold cooling circuits had no descaling interval

actions.actionText: Sort 180 enclosures at the customer facility and hold finished stock of batch B-50440
Descale and flush the cavity 1 cooling channel on the WC-MOLD-01 mold and restore water flow above 6 l/min
Add cooling water flow sensor with low-flow alarm to every cavity circuit on all molding machines

fmeaLink.description: Sink mark from uneven cavity cooling

lessonsLearned.whatWorked: Separating rejects by cavity number on the part stamp isolated cavity 1 at once
lessonsLearned.whatDidnt: Cooling flow per cavity was not measured, so the blockage grew unnoticed

isIsNot.isWhereWhenItHappens: EE-50 top cover over the screw boss - WC-MOLD-01 cavity 1 - batch B-50440
isIsNot.isNotWhereWhenItDoesnt: WC-MOLD-01 cavity 2 - same resin lot RS-4471 and same recipe
isIsNot.notes: Defect follows the cavity, not the recipe or resin
